title.zh: 每增加一个幂级数变量，维数增加1
title.en: Each power-series variable adds one to the dimension

given.zh: $S$ 是 Noether 局部环；常数项映射 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket\to S$ 的核为 $(X)$。
given.en: Let $S$ be a Noetherian local ring. The constant-coefficient map $S\llbracket X\rrbracket\to S$ has kernel $(X)$.

claim.zh: $\dim S\llbracket X\rrbracket=\dim S+1$；递归得到 $\dim \mathbb{C}\llbracket X_0,\dots,X_{n-1}\rrbracket=n$，特别是三元情形维数为 $3$。
claim.en: $\dim S\llbracket X\rrbracket=\dim S+1$. Iteration gives $\dim \mathbb{C}\llbracket X_0,\dots,X_{n-1}\rrbracket=n$, and in particular dimension $3$ for three variables.

statement.zh: $S\llbracket X\rrbracket/(X)\cong S$，且 $X\in\mathfrak{m}$、$X$ 不是零因子。
statement.en: $S\llbracket X\rrbracket/(X)\cong S$, with $X\in\mathfrak{m}$ and $X$ a non-zero-divisor.

reason.zh: 常数项映射满射，核为 $(X)$；$X$ 的常数项为 $0$，所以不是单位。乘 $X$ 只是把系数右移，因而不会把非零级数乘成零。
reason.en: The surjective constant map has kernel $(X)$. Since $X$ has zero constant term it is a nonunit. Multiplication by $X$ shifts coefficients and cannot annihilate a nonzero series.

statement.zh: $\dim S\llbracket X\rrbracket=\dim(S\llbracket X\rrbracket/(X))+1=\dim S+1$。
statement.en: $\dim S\llbracket X\rrbracket=\dim(S\llbracket X\rrbracket/(X))+1=\dim S+1$.

reason.zh: 将 Noether 局部环中的非零因子商环维数定理应用于 $X$，再用上一行的商环同构。
reason.en: Apply the dimension theorem for quotienting a Noetherian local ring by a non-zero-divisor, then use the quotient isomorphism.

statement.zh: $d_0=\dim\mathbb{C}=0$，$d_{n+1}=d_n+1 \Rightarrow d_3=3$。
statement.en: $d_0=\dim\mathbb{C}=0$ and $d_{n+1}=d_n+1$ imply $d_3=3$.

reason.zh: finSuccEquiv 把 $n+1$ 元形式幂级数写成 $n$ 元环上的一元形式幂级数，逐次代入前一行。
reason.en: finSuccEquiv writes $n+1$-variable formal power series as one-variable series over the $n$-variable ring, allowing repeated application of the preceding formula.

title.zh: 变量生成的理想就是极大理想
title.en: The variables generate the maximal ideal

given.zh: 有限多个变量、系数域 $k$；幂级数环在变量生成的理想下已有进完备实例。
given.en: There are finitely many variables over a field $k$, and the power-series ring has an adic-completeness instance for the ideal generated by the variables.

claim.zh: $\mathfrak{m}=(X_i : i\in\sigma)$，所以幂级数环关于其极大理想进完备；三元复系数环也满足这一性质。
claim.en: Its maximal ideal is $\mathfrak{m}=(X_i : i\in\sigma)$, so the ring is complete for its maximal ideal, in particular in the three-variable complex case.

statement.zh: 在 $k[\sigma]$ 中，$I=(X_i)=\ker(\mathrm{constantCoeff})$，且 $k[\sigma]/I\cong k$。
statement.en: In $k[\sigma]$, $I=(X_i)=\ker(\mathrm{constantCoeff})$, and $k[\sigma]/I\cong k$.

reason.zh: 多项式常数项为 $0$ 恰好表示每个单项式都含变量；常数多项式给出满射，所以商环就是系数域。
reason.en: A polynomial has zero constant coefficient exactly when its monomials all contain variables. Constants give surjectivity, identifying the quotient with the coefficient field.

statement.zh: $k$ 是域 $\Rightarrow I$ 极大；$I$ 在 $I$-进完备化中的像仍极大。
statement.en: Since $k$ is a field, $I$ is maximal; its image in the $I$-adic completion remains maximal.

reason.zh: 这里使用有限变量使 $I$ 有限生成，再调用完备化中的极大理想保持定理。
reason.en: Finitely many variables make $I$ finitely generated, allowing the maximal-ideal theorem for the completion.

statement.zh: 经 $k\llbracket\sigma\rrbracket\cong$ 完成环拉回，得到 $\mathfrak{m}=(X_i)$，故关于 $\mathfrak{m}$ 进完备。
statement.en: Transporting along $k\llbracket\sigma\rrbracket\cong$ the completion gives $\mathfrak{m}=(X_i)$, hence $\mathfrak{m}$-adic completeness.

reason.zh: 拉回的变量理想已经极大；局部环只有一个极大理想。用此等式改写已有的变量理想进完备实例。
reason.en: The transported variable ideal is maximal, and the local ring has a unique maximal ideal. Rewrite the existing variable-ideal completeness instance by this equality.

title.zh: 每个剩余类都等于一个常数的剩余类
title.en: Every residue class is the class of a constant

given.zh: $R=\mathbb{C}\llbracket X_0,\dots,X_{n-1}\rrbracket$，常数项映射满射到 $\mathbb{C}$，其核为 $\mathfrak{m}$。
given.en: Let $R=\mathbb{C}\llbracket X_0,\dots,X_{n-1}\rrbracket$. The constant-coefficient map is onto $\mathbb{C}$ and has kernel $\mathfrak{m}$.

claim.zh: 自然映射 $\mathbb{C}\to R/\mathfrak{m}$ 是双射。
claim.en: The natural map $\mathbb{C}\to R/\mathfrak{m}$ is bijective.

statement.zh: $\mathrm{constantCoeff}:R\to\mathbb{C}$ 满射，且 $\ker(\mathrm{constantCoeff})=\mathfrak{m}$。
statement.en: $\mathrm{constantCoeff}:R\to\mathbb{C}$ is surjective and $\ker(\mathrm{constantCoeff})=\mathfrak{m}$.

reason.zh: 每个 $c\in\mathbb{C}$ 都由常数级数 $C(c)$ 映到；满射到域的核在局部环中就是唯一极大理想。
reason.en: Every $c\in\mathbb{C}$ is the image of the constant series $C(c)$. The kernel of this surjection to a field is the unique maximal ideal of the local ring.

statement.zh: 对任意 $f\in R$，$\mathrm{constantCoeff}(f-C(f_0))=f_0-f_0=0$。
statement.en: For every $f\in R$, $\mathrm{constantCoeff}(f-C(f_0))=f_0-f_0=0$.

reason.zh: 因此 $f-C(f_0)\in\mathfrak{m}$，任意剩余类 $[f]$ 都等于 $[C(f_0)]$，证明 $\mathbb{C}\to R/\mathfrak{m}$ 满射。
reason.en: Thus $f-C(f_0)\in\mathfrak{m}$ and every residue class $[f]$ equals $[C(f_0)]$, proving surjectivity of $\mathbb{C}\to R/\mathfrak{m}$.

statement.zh: $\mathbb{C}\to R/\mathfrak{m}$ 单射且满射，因此双射。
statement.en: The map $\mathbb{C}\to R/\mathfrak{m}$ is injective and surjective, hence bijective.

reason.zh: 单射性来自系数域到非零剩余域的保单位环同态；与刚得到的满射性配对。
reason.en: A unital ring map from the field $\mathbb{C}$ to the nonzero residue field is injective. Pair this with the surjectivity just proved.

title.zh: 逐个取出几乎整幂级数的系数
title.en: Recover the coefficients of an almost-integral series

given.zh: $S$ 是 Noether 整闭整环，$K=\mathrm{Frac}(S)$；$f\in K\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 对 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 几乎整。
given.en: Let $S$ be a Noetherian integrally closed domain and $K=\mathrm{Frac}(S)$. Suppose $f\in K\llbracket X\rrbracket$ is almost integral over $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$.

claim.zh: $f$ 的每个系数都来自 $S$，因此存在 $a\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$，其自然像等于 $f$。
claim.en: Every coefficient of $f$ comes from $S$, so $f$ is the image of some $a\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$.

statement.zh: 取 $b\ne 0$，使每个 $n$ 都有 $b f^n=q_n\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$；令 $m=\mathrm{ord}(b)$、$b_m\ne 0$。
statement.en: Choose $b\ne 0$ with $b f^n=q_n\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ for every $n$; put $m=\mathrm{ord}(b)$, so $b_m\ne 0$.

reason.zh: 这正是几乎整性的统一分母条件；最低非零系数 $b_m$ 提供一个属于 $S$ 的固定非零分母。
reason.en: This is the common-denominator condition for almost integrality. The first nonzero coefficient $b_m$ provides a fixed nonzero denominator in $S$.

statement.zh: 取 $X^m$ 系数：$b_m f_0^n=(q_n)_m\in S$，故 $f_0\in S$。
statement.en: Taking the $X^m$ coefficient gives $b_m f_0^n=(q_n)_m\in S$, hence $f_0\in S$.

reason.zh: $b$ 在 $m$ 以前的系数全为 $0$，使卷积只剩 $b_m f_0^n$。于是 $f_0$ 对 $S$ 几乎整；Noether 性给出整性，$S$ 整闭再使 $f_0$ 落回 $S$。
reason.en: All coefficients of $b$ below $m$ vanish, leaving only $b_m f_0^n$ in the convolution. Thus $f_0$ is almost integral over $S$; Noetherianity makes it integral and integral closedness puts it in $S$.

statement.zh: 写 $f-C(f_0)=Xg$，则 $Xg$ 仍对 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 几乎整。
statement.en: Write $f-C(f_0)=Xg$; then $Xg$ is still almost integral over $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$.

reason.zh: 几乎整元构成子环，减去基环中的常数级数保持几乎整性；常数项为零恰好允许除出一个 $X$。
reason.en: Almost-integral elements form a subring, so subtracting a constant series from the base ring preserves the property. Zero constant coefficient allows a factor $X$.

statement.zh: 若 $b(Xg)^n=q_n$，则 $q_n=X^n q_n'$，消去 $X^n$ 得 $b g^n=q_n'\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$。
statement.en: If $b(Xg)^n=q_n$, then $q_n=X^n q_n'$; cancelling $X^n$ gives $b g^n=q_n'\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$.

reason.zh: 等式使 $q_n$ 在次数 $n$ 以下的系数全为零，所以 $X^n$ 在 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 中整除 $q_n$。同一个非零 $b$ 因此也证明 $g$ 几乎整。
reason.en: The equality forces all $q_n$ coefficients below degree $n$ to vanish, giving divisibility by $X^n$ within $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$. The same nonzero $b$ therefore witnesses almost integrality of $g$.

statement.zh: 反复移位得到 $f_j\in S$；令 $a=\sum_j f_j X^j\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$，则 $a$ 的像等于 $f$。
statement.en: Repeated shifts give $f_j\in S$; the series $a=\sum_j f_j X^j\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ maps to $f$.

reason.zh: 对系数编号归纳，每轮把所需系数移到常数项；最后逐系数相等重建整条形式幂级数。
reason.en: Induction on the coefficient index shifts each required coefficient to the constant term. Coefficientwise equality then reconstructs the entire formal series.

title.zh: 把分式域里的整元拉回幂级数环
title.en: Pull integral fraction-field elements back into the ring

given.zh: $S$ 满足上一步假设；令 $F=\mathrm{Frac}(S\llbracket X\rrbracket)$、$K=\mathrm{Frac}(S)$、$B=K\llbracket X\rrbracket$、$L=\mathrm{Frac}(B)$。取 $x\in F$ 对 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 整。
given.en: Under the same hypotheses let $F=\mathrm{Frac}(S\llbracket X\rrbracket)$, $K=\mathrm{Frac}(S)$, $B=K\llbracket X\rrbracket$ and $L=\mathrm{Frac}(B)$. Let $x\in F$ be integral over $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$.

claim.zh: $x$ 已来自 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$；因此 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 整闭。
claim.en: Then $x$ comes from $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$, proving that $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ is integrally closed.

statement.zh: 系数嵌入诱导单射 $\varphi:\mathrm{Frac}(S\llbracket X\rrbracket)\to\mathrm{Frac}(K\llbracket X\rrbracket)$。
statement.en: Coefficient inclusion induces an injection $\varphi:\mathrm{Frac}(S\llbracket X\rrbracket)\to\mathrm{Frac}(K\llbracket X\rrbracket)$.

reason.zh: $S\to K$ 单射，因此级数逐系数映射单射；分式域的延拓仍为单射，可在最后用来拉回等式。
reason.en: $S\to K$ is injective, so the coefficientwise series map is injective. Its fraction-field extension remains injective and will recover the final equality.

statement.zh: $x$ 对 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 整 $\Rightarrow \varphi(x)$ 对 $K\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 整 $\Rightarrow \varphi(x)=f$，$f\in K\llbracket X\rrbracket$。
statement.en: If $x$ is integral over $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$, then $\varphi(x)$ is integral over $K\llbracket X\rrbracket$ and equals some $f\in K\llbracket X\rrbracket$.

reason.zh: 把 $x$ 的首一多项式关系沿 $\varphi$ 映过去并扩大系数环；域系数的一元幂级数环整闭，故像已来自该环。
reason.en: Map the monic relation along $\varphi$ and enlarge the coefficient ring. One-variable power series over a field are integrally closed, so the image is represented in that ring.

statement.zh: $x$ 的统一分母沿 $\varphi$ 传给 $f \Rightarrow f$ 几乎整 $\Rightarrow f$ 来自 $a\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$。
statement.en: Transport the common denominator of $x$ along $\varphi$: $f$ is almost integral, hence comes from $a\in S\llbracket X\rrbracket$.

reason.zh: 整元具有几乎整性；将相应的每个幂等式映过去，就满足上一阶段的系数下降条件。
reason.en: An integral element is almost integral. Mapping its power relations supplies exactly the coefficient-descent hypotheses from the preceding step.

statement.zh: $\varphi(x)=\varphi(a)$ 且 $\varphi$ 单射 $\Rightarrow x=a$。
statement.en: $\varphi(x)=\varphi(a)$ and injectivity of $\varphi$ imply $x=a$.

reason.zh: 任取的分式域整元都来自原幂级数环，这正是 $S\llbracket X\rrbracket$ 整闭的判定条件。
reason.en: Every integral element of its fraction field comes from the power-series ring itself, which is precisely the criterion for integral closedness.

title.zh: 选定 R=ℂ⟦X₀,X₁,X₂⟧，逐项交付性质
title.en: Choose R=ℂ⟦X₀,X₁,X₂⟧ and assemble its properties

given.zh: 维数、极大理想进完备性、剩余域双射以及一元整闭性的保持定理均已证明。
given.en: Dimension, maximal-ideal completeness, residue-field bijectivity and preservation of integral closedness under one power-series variable have been proved.

claim.zh: $R=\mathrm{MvPowerSeries}(\mathrm{Fin}\,3,\mathbb{C})$ 满足目标中全部存在量词和三个最终性质。
claim.en: $R=\mathrm{MvPowerSeries}(\mathrm{Fin}\,3,\mathbb{C})$ satisfies all the existentially quantified structures and all three final properties.

statement.zh: $R_0=\mathbb{C}$ 整闭；$R_{n+1}\cong R_n\llbracket X\rrbracket$，所以 $R_3$ 整闭。
statement.en: $R_0=\mathbb{C}$ is integrally closed, and $R_{n+1}\cong R_n\llbracket X\rrbracket$, so $R_3$ is integrally closed.

reason.zh: 对变量数归纳，每次使用上一阶段的一元整闭性结论；有限元幂级数环同构把结果传回 $R_{n+1}$。
reason.en: Induct on the number of variables, applying the one-variable result each time and transporting it through the finite-variable series equivalence.

statement.zh: 取 $R=R_3=\mathrm{MvPowerSeries}(\mathrm{Fin}\,3,\mathbb{C})$。
statement.en: Choose $R=R_3=\mathrm{MvPowerSeries}(\mathrm{Fin}\,3,\mathbb{C})$.

reason.zh: 该环已有交换环、Noether、局部环与 $\mathbb{C}$-代数结构；系数域的无零因子性给出整环结构，加上上一行的整闭性。
reason.en: This ring already has commutative-ring, Noetherian, local-ring and $\mathbb{C}$-algebra structures. The coefficient field supplies the domain property, and the preceding line supplies integral closedness.

statement.zh: $R$ 关于 $\mathfrak{m}$ 进完备，$\dim R=3$，且 $\mathbb{C}\to R/\mathfrak{m}$ 双射。
statement.en: $R$ is $\mathfrak{m}$-adically complete, $\dim R=3$, and $\mathbb{C}\to R/\mathfrak{m}$ is bijective.

reason.zh: 分别取前面三个独立支路在 $n=3$ 时的结论，填入存在见证之后的三个合取目标，完成 candidate_ring_properties。
reason.en: Specialize the three independent property branches at $n=3$ and fill the three conjuncts following the existential witness, completing candidate_ring_properties.
